design_name: Wheel Drive Bench Demonstrator - Bearing Support POC-06
assumptions: This is one simple bearing-support plate placeholder for a bench-only proof of concept; it is not approved for manufacture, assembly, or powered testing.
Plate dimensions of 30 mm by 30 mm by 4 mm and a centered 12 mm bore are carried forward from the parent exploratory concept.
The centered 12 mm bore is not a specified bearing fit and provides no retention feature.
The plate has no fastener holes, mounting slots, shoulder, material, load rating, or attachment interface.
Plate thickness is along global +Y in a right-handed Z-up coordinate system.
